verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never mentions photo capture, email forwarding, receipt OCR, or automatic matching of receipts to card transactions. The nearest items are generic attachment uploads for bills, vendors and invoices, and marketing copy about transactions being "categorized" and "automatically compliant"; both are adjacent features, not the receipt-capture capability itself. Receipt capture is a core axis for an expense-management product, so the absence of evidence makes this "none" rather than "na".

support.subject: As an employee, I can snap a photo or forward an email and the platform OCRs the receipt and files it against the right transaction
